verdict.rationale: Viam's docs explicitly describe stable hardware-abstraction APIs (e.g., GetImage() uniform across camera brands, same pattern for motors/sensors/arms) backed by a Registry of drivers, with docs stating directly that swapping a camera or motor in config leaves application code unchanged, and that custom hardware behaves like any built-in component once a driver module exists. Community evidence corroborates the open-source gRPC-based architecture underlying these abstractions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification from a third party that swapping real hardware in production leaves code untouched (only vendor docs support this specific claim).
